definitions.gloss: sewing tools; sewing kit; sewing supplies
definitions.explanation: A collection of tools and materials used for sewing by hand or machine, including needles, thread, scissors, pins, and a thimble.

examples.japanese: {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I took out my sewing kit and sewed on a button.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{家庭科|かていか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}わされた。
examples.english: We were made to buy sewing kits for home economics in elementary school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{針山|はりやま}や{糸切|いときり}りばさみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: In my grandmother's sewing kit, there was an old pincushion and thread-cutting scissors.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{裁縫|さいほう}→裁縫：04163_saihou⟧ (sewing, needlework) + ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ (tools, implements). In Japan, children typically purchase a {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (sewing kit set) for {家庭科|かていか} (home economics) class in elementary school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: sewing kit set
- {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}{箱|ばこ}: sewing box
- {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to assemble sewing tools
- {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧: to carry sewing tools

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裁縫箱|さいほうばこ}: sewing box — the container that holds sewing tools
- ソーイング⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: sewing set — English loanword, often refers to compact travel kits
- {針箱|はりばこ}: needle box — traditional term for a sewing box
